title: COPD over-assisted on PSV: ineffective efforts
summary: PS 16 with ETS 10% prolongs insufflation and traps gas. Weak efforts (Pmax 5) cannot overcome intrinsic PEEP and the residual expiratory flow; the flow trace shows a notch and Paw a dip with no breath delivered.
objectives: Find the missed efforts: an expiratory flow notch toward zero with a small Paw dip and no trigger.
Fix it by lowering PS, raising ETS to shorten Ti, and adding external PEEP to offset PEEPi.

fix.note: Tassaux-style: ETS 70% to shorten Ti, PS down to 6, PEEP 5 against PEEPi, trigger 1.5 L/min.
